Name: Stats Tracker
Author: bobdawei
Description:
[size=5]Stats Tracker[/size]
Ever wondered how many fish you've caught, how many monsters you've slain, or how many times you've been knocked out? Stats Tracker adds an in-game leaderboard that lets you view a comprehensive breakdown of your player statistics at any time.
[size=5]Features[/size][list]
[*]Press [b]L[/b] (configurable) to open the leaderboard at any time during gameplay
[*]Tracks over 35 built in stats and 40 custom stats, including gold earned, fish caught, monsters killed, items crafted, geodes cracked, and many more
[*]Scrollable UI built in Stardew's native visual style
[*]Hotkey configurable through config.json or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿
[*]Full multiplayer support, including highlighting the winner of each stat
[*]Persistent save data for both host and farmhand
[/list][size=5]Requirements[/size][list]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0 or later
[*]Optional: Generic Mod Config Menu for in-game hotkey configuration
[/list][size=5]Installation[/size][list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] if you haven't already
[*]Download and unzip this mod into your [code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code] folder
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI
[/list][size=5]Updating
[/size][size=2][b]Updating the mod:[/b] If you're playing multiplayer and you play as a farmhand (not the host), your custom stats are stored in

[code]Stardew Valley/Mods/leaderboard/data/
[/code][b]
Back up this folder before updating to a new version to avoid losing your data[/b]. Host players don't need to worry about this, their data is stored in the save file. The save data is just a simple JSON, you can just copy and paste the values while you update

[/size][size=5]Usage[/size]
Press [b]L[/b] (configurable) while in-game[size=2] to open the stats leaderboard. Close it with the X button or Escape.
[/size]
[size=5]Compatibility[/size][list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.6 and later
[*]Should be compatible with most other mods as it only reads game data and adds a UI element
[/list][size=5]Known Issues[/size][list]
[*][size=2]All non native stats (anything listed in the Planned Stats list below) have to track continuously based off of gameplay. This means if the mod was installed part way through a playthrough, those stats will only start counting from the time of mod install. Some stats just mean they're out of date, others mean they break entirely and won't show accurately[/size]
[*]Updating the mod clears all data for farmhands (multiplayer guests). To avoid this, backup your data in Stardew Valley/Mods/leaderboard/data/ or remember the values and add them back to that JSON after the update
